item.title: Toronto cyclists frustrated by snow-blocked bike lanes week after record storm
item.description: TORONTO — Safety concerns have been top of mind for some Toronto cyclists who are voicing their frustrations over bike lanes still blocked by snow and ice a week after a historic storm blanketed the city.

item.title: Conservatives, Poilievre seek to carry convention momentum back into Parliament
item.description: OTTAWA — Political analysts say the federal Conservatives and leader Pierre Poilievre have momentum coming off a unifying convention in Calgary but the party still has a hill to climb in Parliament to one-up Prime Minster Mark Carney and the Liberals

item.title: Powassan's McGill to attend CFL Invitational Combine
item.description: McGill is looking to get the attention of CFL scouts in Waterloo.

item.title: VIDEO: Finding forgiveness in the wreckage of the Humboldt bus tragedy
item.description: Scott Thomas — who lost his son, Evan, in the Humboldt Broncos bus crash — joined our podcast for a heartfelt discussion about fact, fiction and why he chose to forgive the trucker who ran the stop sign

item.title: Montrealers protest Trump immigration crackdown, call out Canadian ‘complicity’
item.description: MONTREAL — Demonstrators gathered in Montreal on Sunday to protest the controversial crackdown by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, calling out ICE tactics as well as Canadian "complicity" in them.

item.title: Battalion fall to buzzer beater in Niagara
item.description: Ryan Roobroeck sent home the game winning goal for Niagara with 1.8 seconds left in the third.

item.title: Three men arrested in Surrey, B.C., after alleged extortion-related shooting
item.description: SURREY — Police in Surrey, B.C., arrested three men on Sunday after early morning gunfire at a home, believed to be yet another example of extortion-related shootings that have plagued the city in recent months.

item.title: Thousands rally in Toronto to support Iran uprising, call for regime change
item.description: TORONTO — Thousands of people gathered in downtown Toronto on Sunday to protest Iran’s Islamic Republic and voice support for Iranians killed during weeks of countrywide unrest.

item.title: Battalion prospect thriving with the Voodoos named NOJHL rookie of the month
item.description: The NOJHL announced that Pereira was the NOJHL Journal Printing Rookie of the Month for January.

item.title: Preliminary, partial results put Costa Rican president's handpicked successor on verge of presidency
item.description: CARTAGO, Costa Rica (AP) — Preliminary and partial results showed the Costa Rican president’s handpicked successor poised to win the presidency in a crowded field after Sunday's election.
